reference.solver: Attributed shared SciPy factor/extended original-residual policy; no PyMHM numerical assembly/basis

scope: Whole original uncondensed P2/P0 weak Dirichlet problem on all ten actual meshes; K=I and macro P0 projection of the sine source.
Each field is evaluated using its own executed numerical basis, geometry and portable coefficient components; no basis replacement or coefficient transfer.
Original equations and physical norm agreement are distinct acceptance criteria; no continuum accuracy or uniform inf-sup follows from the residual.

The gradient observer fits the actual represented affine P2 gradient, records its fit residual, and preserves both fine-facet sides. Divergence is compared to the projected constant source, not the original sine forcing.
The special tetra/cube K=I/P0 ideal polynomial-space proof is distinct from a generic finite-local API claim.
Shared attributed SciPy factorization and extended original-residual arithmetic are not independent; operator, basis, projection and norm assembly are independent.
